mapper.sql: trip_id, user_id, title, destination_name, start_date, end_date, companion_type, companion_count, purpose, budget_amount, currency_code, transport_preference, food_preference, pace, accommodation_style, status, source, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trips ( user_id, title, destination_name, start_date, end_date, companion_type, companion_count, purpose, budget_amount, currency_code, transport_preference, food_preference, pace, accommodation_style, status, source ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{destinationName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{companionType}, COALESCE(#{companionCount}, 1), #{purpose}, #{budgetAmount}, COALESCE(#{currencyCode}, 'KRW'), #{transportPreference}, #{foodPreference}, #{pace}, #{accommodationStyle}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'DRAFT'), COALESCE(#{source}, 'MANUAL') )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM trips WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM trips WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY start_date DESC, trip_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE trips SET title = #{title}, destination_name = #{destinationName}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, companion_type = #{companionType}, companion_count = #{companionCount}, purpose = #{purpose}, budget_amount = #{budgetAmount}, currency_code = #{currencyCode}, transport_preference = #{transportPreference}, food_preference = #{foodPreference}, pace = #{pace}, accommodation_style = #{accommodationStyle}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE trips SET status = 'CANCELLED', deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
